summary: AISDLC-1179.1 marked landed by the reconciler from filing PR #2546 (cli-file --update branch ai-sdlc/update-aisdlc-1179.1, merge 27afc606) although no AC-4 work exists: remove the success verdict from done/ and re-enqueue from the task brief

options.description: Dispatch runs remove-verdict --task-id AISDLC-1179.1 --from done --with-manifest, then enqueue --from-brief tasks-aisdlc-1179.1.md; the task runs under its own id. Recommended.
Keep 1179.1 in done/ and reopen AC-4 under a new task id; leaves a false success verdict in the ledger.

body: The landing record for #2546 reads kind task, state merged, action mark-landed, taskId AISDLC-1179.1. The verdict in done/ carries landedSha 27afc606 and prUrl null; the task file is still in backlog/tasks on main and no worktree or code PR for AC-4 was ever created. Cause: DOCS_BRANCH_PREFIXES in pipeline-cli/src/hierarchy/reconcile.ts lists ai-sdlc/file- and docs/ but not ai-sdlc/update-, so detectKind returns task for an update filing whose title names the task id. Class (a): restoring a true board state loosens no control and is reversible with write-verdict. A bug task (AISDLC-1235) tightens the reconciler.
